event.title: Paramount Completes $81 Billion Merger with Warner Bros to Form Skydance
event.canonical_title: Paramount Completes $81 Billion Merger with Warner Bros to Form Skydance
event.summary: Paramount has finalized its $81 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, resulting in the formation of a new entertainment entity named Skydance. This merger consolidates significant power within the media industry, which is already dominated by a few major players. Following the merger, company leaders have indicated potential cost-cutting measures due to the debt incurred from the acquisition.
